       1             SENATOR MARCELLINO:  My name is

       8             We are here today on a joint meeting and a

       9      joint hearing on tax policy, and we're trying to do

      10      some reform of the tax policy for New York State.

      11             We are, as everybody knows, the highest-taxed

      12      state in the nation, if not the highest, one of

      13      them, and which is not exactly the position you want

      14      to be in, and it's a position I'd rather be last

      15      than first, if possible.

      17      we're losing people of all age ranges.

      19      it's only the older folks who have a lot of money

      21      their estate; so they have the mobility, they'll go

      22      to states where there's no income tax, and something

      23      like that.

       2             We can't bring businesses here.

       3             We're having trouble getting businesses to

       4      come here, we're having trouble getting businesses

       5      to stay here.

       7      not always successful.

       9      looking for ideas, and we're looking for

      10      suggestions.

       1             So while the property-tax cap was an

      11      last week with Senator Valesky.

      12             As I'm sure you all know very well, the

      13      current law imposes a standard of absolute liability

      15      gravity-related injuries.

      17      Senator Gallivan, that would replace the

      21      worker's failure to follow the safety training, use

      22      available safety devices, his own intoxication, or

      23      commission of a crime.

      25      held fully liable and the injured worker may still

       1      could add anywhere from 8 percent to 30 percent to

       1      15 percent of our present total taxable income.

      12      New York to other states, particularly to a place

      14      income tax.

       1      overwhelming impact on the budget as to be unable to

       1      and local taxes.
